record.destination: Both hands are seated against the centre line the way a live EZ Baccarat layout is dealt: each seat's two-card group holds its INNER edge the same measured distance off the divider, each seat's total rides beside the divider instead of at the felt's outer edge, and each sideways third card lies OUTBOARD of its own group — the player's to its left, per the casino reference photo. A fresh agent can tell it has arrived by measuring: player inner edge to centre line equals banker inner edge to centre line, and both totals are nearer the divider than the felt's rim.

payload.body: Cause of today's look: #row-hands is grid-template-columns minmax(0,1fr) 132px minmax(0,1fr) and .hand is align-content:start with everything flush-LEFT in its own column. The banker's column starts at the divider, so the banker already looks seated; the player's column starts at the felt's left rim, so the player's cards and total drift 500-odd px away from the line. Only the player half actually looks wrong, but the symmetry has to be stated as a rule or the next change breaks it again. Third card today: .card.is-third rotate(90deg) translate(6px,-4px), appended LAST to a plain row flex, so it lands to the RIGHT of the pair on both seats. rotate() does not change the layout box, so the rotated card's 132px visual width overhangs its 92px slot by 20px each side. Jim's brief, verbatim in spirit: player score centred and just left of the centre line not far left; players first two cards so the right edge is equidistant from the left part of the centre line; third card to the left and sideways like the reference image. Repo constraints that bind the shape of the fix: framework-free DOM, CSS custom-property tokens in tokens.css, house style wants a pure testable seam plus a CSS-text guard (see src/ui/table-shell.test.ts), bun test plus tsc --noEmit gate, prefers-reduced-motion honoured.
